_comment: Template for the campaign configuration read by run-campaign.ps1. Copy it OUTSIDE the repository (for example into the neutral trial root), edit the paths to this machine, and never commit the copy: it holds local paths. Every path is absolute. The trial root and every client home must be outside the user profile and the temporary folder and must not contain the operating-system user name (the harness refuses otherwise). With the default -Credential ApiKey, clientHome holds no sign-in (no .credentials.json; Claude Code takes its key from the user environment variable VSIFT_TRIALS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) and codexClientHome holds only an API-key login (codex login --with-api-key): keep both apart from the sign-in homes a -Credential SignIn batch uses.
